newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power raises Wed firm offers by $1/MWh.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power raises Wed firm offers by $1/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) raised its price offers for next-day firm sales during heavy-load hours by $1.00 a megawatt hour (MWh), the federal power marketing agency said Tuesday.
In addition, sales volumes during hours 1300 to 2100 PDT on Wednesday were limited to 200 megawatts.
Firm electricity during those same hours was offered at $20.00 per MWh, up from $19.00 for Tuesday.
Power during 0700-1200 and the hours ending 2200 and 2300 PDT on Wednesday was offered at $18.00, compared with $17.00 for Tuesday schedulings.
Non-firm power was still offered at the Tuesday prices.
Off-peak prices were also unchanged at $13.00 for both firm and non-firm sales.
